    "Initial setup and customization can be time-consuming for one person.",
    "Lacks some industry-specific features for entertainment workflows.",
    "Customer support can be slow to resolve complex issues."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "As a Senior Overseer & Operations Manager for a self-employed entertainment business, this individual likely found Zoho CRM to be a valuable, cost-effective tool for managing their diverse operational needs. The platform's extensive features allowed for a centralized approach to client and project management, streamlining many administrative tasks. While it required a significant investment of time to configure initially and lacked some niche entertainment functionalities, the overall value and capability to automate processes made it a strong asset for their business."
